_label: Good-before-bad duplicate-name probe (round-4 HIGH gap), FAILURE variant: [guard COMPLETED/SUCCESS, guard COMPLETED/FAILURE]. Complements t25 (a completed-but-bad conclusion, not merely an incomplete status) so ordering/truncation is the only thing under test, isolated from the status!=COMPLETED branch. A first-wins truncation (matches[:1]) sees only the leading SUCCESS entry and masks the trailing genuine FAILURE. Must exit 2.
